facts.fact: The Herald describes Impilo as the Ministry of Health's own electronic health records platform, designed to connect care, diagnostics, health records and logistics in a national digital environment; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Directorate of Laboratory Services
systems.tiers: 117 main laboratories, linked to lower-level laboratories; National Health Laboratory Strategic Plan 2025-2030 targets 80 percent of health facilities
